docs.title: Boiled Green Beans | 水煮四季豆
docs.text: Quick Info | 快速信息 - ⏱️ Prep Time | 准备时间: 5 minutes | 5分钟 - 🔥 Cook Time | 烹饪时间: 6 minutes | 6分钟 - 🍽️ Servings | 份量: 1 serving | 1人份 - 📊 Difficulty | 难度: Easy | 简单

docs.title: 📝 Description | 菜品介绍
docs.text:
English: This simple boiled green beans recipe is a healthy, no-oil cooking method that preserves the natural flavor and nutrients of the beans. With just a touch of salt and sesame oil, it's light, refreshing, and perfect for those seeking minimalist vegetarian cuisine. Ready in just 11 minutes.

中文： 这道简单的水煮四季豆是一种健康、无油的烹饪方法，保留了豆子的天然风味和营养。仅用少许盐和香油，清淡爽口，非常适合追求极简素食的人群。仅需11分钟即可完成。

docs.title: 🥘 Ingredients | 食材清单
docs.text:
Ingredient 食材 Quantity 分量 Notes 备注 Fresh Green Beans 新鲜四季豆 200g 200克 Trimmed 去蒂 Salt 盐 1.5g 1.5克 A pinch 一小撮 Sesame Oil 香油 3ml 3毫升 Optional 可选 Water 水 600ml 600毫升 For boiling 用于煮制

Notes on Measurements | 分量说明: - All measurements are precise in grams (g) or milliliters (ml) for consistency 所有分量均以克(g)或毫升(ml)为单位，保持一致性 - Sesame oil is optional but adds nice aroma 香油是可选的，但能增加香气 - Use enough water to fully submerge the beans 使用足够的水完全淹没豆子

docs.title: Step 1 | 第一步: Prepare the Beans | 准备四季豆
docs.text:
English: Wash the green beans thoroughly. Trim off both ends. If desired, cut into 5-6 cm lengths or leave whole. Remove any strings from older beans.

中文： 彻底清洗四季豆。去掉两端。如需要，切成5-6厘米长的段或保持完整。去除老豆的豆筋。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: Leaving beans whole looks more elegant for presentation. 保持豆子完整摆盘更美观。

docs.title: Step 2 | 第二步: Boil Water | 烧水
docs.text:
English: Pour 600ml of water into a pot and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Add a pinch of salt to the water once boiling.

中文： 将600毫升水倒入锅中，大火煮沸。水沸腾后加入一小撮盐。

⚠️ Important | 注意事项: Salted boiling water helps maintain the beans' vibrant green color. 盐水煮沸有助于保持豆子鲜艳的翠绿色。

docs.title: Step 3 | 第三步: Add Beans | 加入豆子
docs.text:
English: Carefully add the green beans to the boiling water. They should be fully submerged. Reduce heat to medium-high to maintain a gentle boil.

中文： 小心将四季豆加入沸水中。应该完全淹没。转中大火保持轻微沸腾。

🌟 Pro Tip | 专业技巧: Don't overcrowd the pot; cook in batches if necessary. 不要过度拥挤锅子；必要时分批煮制。

docs.title: Step 4 | 第四步: Cook | 煮制
docs.text:
English: Boil the beans for 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp. Test by piercing with a fork - it should go through easily but the bean should still have a slight snap. Don't overcook.

中文： 将豆子煮4-5分钟至嫩脆。用叉子刺穿测试——应该轻松穿过但豆子仍略有弹性。不要过度煮制。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: Properly cooked beans should be bright green, not dull or olive-colored. 正确烹饪的豆子应该是鲜绿色，不是暗色或橄榄色。

docs.title: Step 5 | 第五步: Drain and Season | 沥干调味
docs.text:
English: Drain the beans immediately and transfer to a serving bowl. While still hot, drizzle with 3ml of sesame oil (if using) and sprinkle with remaining salt. Toss gently to coat evenly. Serve warm or at room temperature.

中文： 立即沥干豆子并装入碗中。趁热淋上3毫升香油（如使用）并撒上剩余的盐。轻轻搅拌使其均匀包裹。温热或室温食用。

docs.title: ✨ Characteristics | 菜品特点
docs.text:
Flavor Profile | 口味特点: - 🟢 Clean and Pure | 纯净清新 - 🟢 Tender-Crisp | 嫩脆可口 - 🟢 Subtle Sesame Aroma | 淡淡芝麻香 - 🟢 Light and Healthy | 清淡健康

Nutritional Highlights | 营养亮点: - Very low in calories (only 31 kcal per 100g) | 极低卡路里（每100克仅31千卡） - No added oil (except optional sesame oil) | 无添加油（除可选香油外） - High in vitamins and minerals | 富含维生素和矿物质 - Excellent source of dietary fiber | 优质膳食纤维来源

Best Served | 最佳食用方式: - As a light side dish | 作为清淡配菜 - In salads or cold dishes | 用于沙拉或凉菜 - Perfect for detox meals | 适合排毒餐 - Great for summer dining | 适合夏季用餐

docs.title: 🔄 Variations | 变化做法
docs.text:
Option 1 | 做法一: Garlic Sauce | 蒜泥版 Mix minced garlic with a little soy sauce and drizzle over beans. 将蒜末与少许酱油混合，淋在豆子上。

Option 2 | 做法二: Vinegar Dressing | 醋汁版 Add 5ml of rice vinegar with the sesame oil. 加香油时加入5毫升米醋。

Option 3 | 做法三: Plain | 原味版 Skip the sesame oil for the purest taste. 省略香油以获得最纯粹的味道。

docs.title: 📌 Storage Tips | 储存建议
docs.text:
• Refrigerator | 冷藏: Store in an airtight container for up to 2 days 放入密封容器中冷藏，最多保存2天

  • Reheating | 重新加热: Best served cold or at room temperature 最好冷食或室温食用

  • Freezing | 冷冻: Blanch and freeze for up to 3 months 焯水后冷冻可保存最多3个月

  • Best enjoyed fresh | 最好现做现吃: Consume within a few hours for best texture 为获得最佳口感，建议在几小时内食用

docs.title: Boiled Green Peas | 水煮豌豆
docs.text: Quick Info | 快速信息 - ⏱️ Prep Time | 准备时间: 3 minutes | 3分钟 - 🔥 Cook Time | 烹饪时间: 5 minutes | 5分钟 - 🍽️ Servings | 份量: 1 serving | 1人份 - 📊 Difficulty | 难度: Easy | 简单

docs.title: 📝 Description | 菜品介绍
docs.text:
English: This traditional Chinese-style boiled green peas is the simplest way to enjoy fresh peas. With just a pinch of salt and optional sesame oil, it preserves the natural sweetness and tender texture of the peas. Perfect as a healthy snack or side dish, it takes only 8 minutes from start to finish.

中文： 这道传统中式水煮豌豆是享受新鲜豌豆的最简单方式。仅用少许盐和可选香油，保留了豌豆的天然甜味和嫩滑口感。作为健康零食或配菜非常完美，从开始到完成仅需8分钟。

docs.title: 🥘 Ingredients | 食材清单
docs.text:
Ingredient 食材 Quantity 分量 Notes 备注 Fresh Green Peas 新鲜豌豆 150g 150克 Shelled 去壳 Salt 盐 1g 1克 A pinch 一小撮 Sesame Oil 香油 2ml 2毫升 Optional 可选 Water 水 400ml 400毫升 For boiling 用于煮制

Notes on Measurements | 分量说明: - All measurements are precise in grams (g) or milliliters (ml) for consistency 所有分量均以克(g)或毫升(ml)为单位，保持一致性 - One cup of shelled peas weighs approximately 150g 一杯去壳豌豆约重150克 - Use less salt to let the natural sweetness shine through 少放盐以突出天然甜味

docs.title: Step 1 | 第一步: Prepare the Peas | 准备豌豆
docs.text:
English: If using fresh pea pods, shell them to extract the peas. Rinse the peas under cold water and drain. If using frozen peas, no need to thaw.

中文： 如果使用新鲜豆荚，去壳取出豌豆。在冷水下冲洗豌豆并沥干。如果使用冷冻豌豆，无需解冻。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: Fresh peas have better texture, but frozen peas are convenient. 新鲜豌豆口感更好，但冷冻豌豆更方便。

docs.title: Step 2 | 第二步: Boil Water | 烧水
docs.text:
English: Pour 400ml of water into a pot and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. This should take about 2-3 minutes.

中文： 将400毫升水倒入锅中，大火煮沸。大约需要2-3分钟。

⚠️ Important | 注意事项: Use enough water to fully submerge the peas for even cooking. 使用足够的水完全淹没豌豆以确保均匀受热。

docs.title: Step 3 | 第三步: Add Peas | 加入豌豆
docs.text:
English: Once the water is boiling, carefully add the peas. Reduce heat to medium and let it simmer gently.

中文： 水沸腾后，小心加入豌豆。转中火，让其轻轻沸腾。

🌟 Pro Tip | 专业技巧: Adding peas to boiling water helps preserve their bright green color. 将豌豆加入沸水中有助于保持其鲜艳的翠绿色。

docs.title: Step 4 | 第四步: Cook | 煮制
docs.text:
English: Simmer the peas for 3-4 minutes until tender but still slightly firm. Fresh peas cook faster than frozen. Test by tasting one pea - it should be sweet and tender.

中文： 将豌豆煮3-4分钟至嫩但仍略有弹性。新鲜豌豆比冷冻豌豆熟得快。尝一粒测试——应该甜而嫩。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: Don't overcook, as the peas will become mushy and lose their sweetness. 不要过度煮制，否则豌豆会变软烂并失去甜味。

docs.title: Step 5 | 第五步: Season and Serve | 调味上桌
docs.text:
English: Drain the peas and transfer to a serving bowl. While still hot, drizzle with 2ml of sesame oil (if using) and sprinkle with 1g of salt. Toss gently to distribute evenly. Serve immediately.

中文： 沥干豌豆并装入碗中。趁热淋上2毫升香油（如使用）并撒上1克盐。轻轻搅拌使其均匀分布。立即食用。

docs.title: ✨ Characteristics | 菜品特点
docs.text:
Flavor Profile | 口味特点: - 🟢 Pure Natural Sweetness | 纯粹天然甜味 - 🟢 Tender and Smooth | 嫩滑顺口 - 🟢 Light and Clean | 清淡纯净 - 🟢 Minimalist Flavor | 极简风味

Nutritional Highlights | 营养亮点: - Very low in calories (only 81 kcal per 100g) | 极低卡路里（每100克仅81千卡） - High in plant-based protein | 高植物蛋白 - Rich in vitamins and minerals | 富含维生素和矿物质 - No added fat (except optional sesame oil) | 无添加脂肪（除可选香油外）

Best Served | 最佳食用方式: - As a healthy snack | 作为健康零食 - In salads or grain bowls | 用于沙拉或谷物碗 - Perfect for weight management meals | 适合体重管理餐 - Great for children's meals | 适合儿童餐

docs.title: 🔄 Variations | 变化做法
docs.text:
Option 1 | 做法一: Mint Version | 薄荷版 Add 2g of chopped fresh mint before serving. 装盘前加入2克切碎的新鲜薄荷。

Option 2 | 做法二: Lemon Version | 柠檬版 Squeeze 5ml of lemon juice over the peas. 在豌豆上挤5毫升柠檬汁。

Option 3 | 做法三: Plain | 原味版 Skip the sesame oil for the purest taste. 省略香油以获得最纯粹的味道。

docs.title: 📌 Storage Tips | 储存建议
docs.text:
• Refrigerator | 冷藏: Store in an airtight container for up to 2 days 放入密封容器中冷藏，最多保存2天

  • Reheating | 重新加热: Reheat in microwave for 20-30 seconds or in boiling water for 30 seconds 微波炉加热20-30秒或在沸水中煮30秒

  • Freezing | 冷冻: Can be frozen for up to 2 months 可冷冻保存最多2个月

  • Best enjoyed fresh | 最好现做现吃: For optimal sweetness, consume within a few hours 为获得最佳甜味，建议在几小时内食用

docs.title: Boiled Sweet Corn | 水煮甜玉米
docs.text: Quick Info | 快速信息 - ⏱️ Prep Time | 准备时间: 3 minutes | 3分钟 - 🔥 Cook Time | 烹饪时间: 8 minutes | 8分钟 - 🍽️ Servings | 份量: 1 serving | 1人份 - 📊 Difficulty | 难度: Easy | 简单

docs.title: 📝 Description | 菜品介绍
docs.text:
English: This traditional Chinese-style boiled sweet corn is the simplest way to enjoy fresh corn. With just a pinch of salt, it preserves the natural sweetness and juicy texture of the corn kernels. Perfect as a healthy snack or side dish, it takes only 11 minutes from start to finish.

中文： 这道传统中式水煮甜玉米是享受新鲜玉米的最简单方式。仅用少许盐，保留了玉米粒的天然甜味和多汁口感。作为健康零食或配菜非常完美，从开始到完成仅需11分钟。

docs.title: 🥘 Ingredients | 食材清单
docs.text:
Ingredient 食材 Quantity 分量 Notes 备注 Fresh Sweet Corn Kernels 新鲜甜玉米粒 200g 200克 From 1-2 ears of corn 来自1-2根玉米棒 Salt 盐 1g 1克 A pinch 一小撮 Water 水 500ml 500毫升 For boiling 用于煮制

Notes on Measurements | 分量说明: - All measurements are precise in grams (g) or milliliters (ml) for consistency 所有分量均以克(g)或毫升(ml)为单位，保持一致性 - One ear of corn yields approximately 100-120g of kernels 一根玉米棒约产出100-120克玉米粒 - Use less salt to let the natural sweetness shine through 少放盐以突出天然甜味

docs.title: Step 1 | 第一步: Prepare the Corn | 准备玉米
docs.text:
English: If using whole corn cobs, remove the kernels by cutting downward with a sharp knife. Rinse the kernels under cold water and drain. If using frozen corn, no need to thaw.

中文： 如果使用整根玉米棒，用刀向下切去除玉米粒。在冷水下冲洗玉米粒并沥干。如果使用冷冻玉米，无需解冻。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: Fresh corn gives the best flavor, but frozen corn works well too. 新鲜玉米味道最佳，但冷冻玉米也不错。

docs.title: Step 2 | 第二步: Boil Water | 烧水
docs.text:
English: Pour 500ml of water into a pot and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. This should take about 3-4 minutes.

中文： 将500毫升水倒入锅中，大火煮沸。大约需要3-4分钟。

⚠️ Important | 注意事项: Use enough water to fully submerge the corn kernels for even cooking. 使用足够的水完全淹没玉米粒以确保均匀受热。

docs.title: Step 3 | 第三步: Add Corn | 加入玉米
docs.text:
English: Once the water is boiling, carefully add the corn kernels. Reduce heat to medium and let it simmer gently.

中文： 水沸腾后，小心加入玉米粒。转中火，让其轻轻沸腾。

🌟 Pro Tip | 专业技巧: Adding corn to boiling water helps seal in the natural sugars and sweetness. 将玉米加入沸水中有助于锁住天然糖分和甜味。

docs.title: Step 4 | 第四步: Cook | 煮制
docs.text:
English: Simmer the corn for 5-6 minutes until tender but still slightly crisp. Fresh corn cooks faster than frozen. Test by tasting one kernel - it should be sweet and juicy.

中文： 将玉米煮5-6分钟至嫩但仍略微脆爽。新鲜玉米比冷冻玉米熟得快。尝一粒测试——应该甜而多汁。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: Don't overcook, as the corn will become mushy and lose its sweetness. 不要过度煮制，否则玉米会变软烂并失去甜味。

docs.title: Step 5 | 第五步: Season and Serve | 调味上桌
docs.text:
English: Drain the corn and transfer to a serving bowl. Sprinkle with 1g of salt while still hot. Toss gently to distribute the salt evenly. Serve immediately.

中文： 沥干玉米并装入碗中。趁热撒上1克盐。轻轻搅拌使盐均匀分布。立即食用。

docs.title: ✨ Characteristics | 菜品特点

Nutritional Highlights | 营养亮点: - Very low in calories (only 86 kcal per 100g) | 极低卡路里（每100克仅86千卡） - High in dietary fiber | 富含膳食纤维 - Rich in B vitamins and minerals | 富含B族维生素和矿物质 - No added fat | 无添加脂肪

docs.title: 📝 Description | 菜品介绍
docs.text:
English: This classic braised eggplant is soft, flavorful, and absorbs the savory sauce beautifully. The eggplant becomes melt-in-your-mouth tender while maintaining its shape. This simple one-ingredient-focused recipe takes only 20 minutes and pairs perfectly with steamed rice. It's a comforting Chinese home-style dish that's naturally vegan.

中文： 这道经典红烧茄子柔软入味，完美吸收咸鲜酱汁。茄子变得入口即化同时保持形状完整。这道以单一食材为主的简单菜谱仅需20分钟，与蒸米饭搭配完美。这是一道天然素食的中式家常 comfort food。

docs.title: 🥘 Ingredients | 食材清单
docs.text:
Ingredient 食材 Quantity 分量 Notes 备注 Eggplant 茄子 250g 250克 1 medium eggplant 1个中等大小茄子 Garlic 大蒜 10g 10克 Minced (2-3 cloves) 切末（2-3瓣） Ginger 姜 5g 5克 Minced 切末 Salt 盐 2g 2克 To taste 适量 Sugar 糖 4g 4克 Balance flavors 平衡味道 Soy Sauce 酱油 10ml 10毫升 Light soy sauce 生抽 Cooking Oil 食用油 20ml 20毫升 Vegetable oil 植物油 Water 水 80ml 80毫升 For braising 用于红烧 Cornstarch 玉米淀粉 5g 5克 Mixed with 10ml water 与10毫升水混合

Notes on Measurements | 分量说明: - All measurements are precise in grams (g) or milliliters (ml) for consistency 所有分量均以克(g)或毫升(ml)为单位，保持一致性 - One medium eggplant weighs approximately 250-300g 一个中等大小的茄子约重250-300克 - Eggplant absorbs oil easily, so measure oil carefully 茄子容易吸油，请仔细测量油量

docs.title: Step 1 | 第一步: Prepare the Eggplant | 准备茄子
docs.text:
English: Wash the eggplant thoroughly. Cut off the stem and slice into 2-3 cm thick rounds, then cut each round into quarters. Sprinkle 1g of salt over the eggplant pieces and let them sit for 5 minutes to draw out excess moisture. Pat dry with paper towels. Mince the garlic and ginger.

中文： 彻底清洗茄子。去掉蒂部，切成2-3厘米厚的圆片，然后将每片切成四等份。在茄子上撒1克盐，静置5分钟以去除多余水分。用厨房纸巾拍干。将大蒜和姜切末。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: Salting reduces oil absorption and prevents the eggplant from becoming too greasy. 加盐可减少吸油量，防止茄子过于油腻。

docs.title: Step 2 | 第二步: Pan-Fry the Eggplant | 煎茄子
docs.text:
English: Heat a non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat. Add 15ml of cooking oil and swirl to coat. Add the eggplant pieces in a single layer and cook for 3-4 minutes until golden brown on one side. Flip and cook for another 2-3 minutes. Remove and set aside.

中文： 将不粘锅或炒锅置于中大火上。加入15毫升食用油，晃动覆盖锅底。将茄子块单层放入，煎3-4分钟至一面金黄。翻面再煎2-3分钟。取出备用。

⚠️ Important | 注意事项: Don't overcrowd the pan; cook in batches if necessary for even browning. 不要过度拥挤锅子；必要时分批煎制以确保均匀上色。

docs.title: Step 3 | 第三步: Sauté Aromatics | 炒香调料
docs.text:
English: Add the remaining 5ml of oil to the same pan over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 15-20 seconds until fragrant. Be careful not to burn them.

中文： 在同一锅中加入剩余的5毫升油，中火加热。加入蒜末和姜末，翻炒15-20秒至出香味。注意不要烧焦。

🌟 Pro Tip | 专业技巧: Using the same pan retains all the flavorful bits from the eggplant. 使用同一个锅可保留茄子的所有风味物质。

docs.title: Step 4 | 第四步: Braise | 红烧
docs.text:
English: Return the fried eggplant to the pan. Add 80ml of water, 10ml of soy sauce, 1g of salt, and 4g of sugar. Stir gently to combine. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes until the eggplant is very tender.

中文： 将煎好的茄子放回锅中。加入80毫升水、10毫升酱油、1克盐和4克糖。轻轻搅拌使其混合。煮沸后转小火。盖上锅盖，慢炖5分钟至茄子非常软嫩。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: The eggplant should be fork-tender but still hold its shape. 茄子应该用叉子可以轻松刺穿但仍保持形状。

docs.title: Step 5 | 第五步: Thicken Sauce and Serve | 勾芡上桌
docs.text:
English: Mix 5g of cornstarch with 10ml of water to create a slurry. Remove the lid and increase heat to medium. Stir the cornstarch slurry and pour it into the pan while stirring constantly. Cook for 1 minute until the sauce thickens and coats the eggplant. Transfer to a serving plate and serve hot with steamed rice.

中文： 将5克玉米淀粉与10毫升水混合制成淀粉水。打开锅盖，将火调至中火。搅拌淀粉水并倒入锅中，同时不断搅拌。煮1分钟至酱汁浓稠并包裹茄子。装入盘中，趁热配蒸米饭食用。

Option 1 | 做法一: Spicy Version | 辣味版 Add 2g of chili bean paste (doubanjiang) when sautéing aromatics. 炒调料时加入2克豆瓣酱。

Option 2 | 做法二: Vinegar Finish | 醋溜版 Add 5ml of black vinegar at the end for a tangy note. 最后加入5毫升陈醋增加酸爽风味。

Option 3 | 做法三: Minimalist | 极简版 Skip the cornstarch slurry for a lighter, broth-like sauce. 省略淀粉水，获得更清淡的汤汁。

docs.text:

  • Reheating | 重新加热: Reheat gently in a pan over low heat with a splash of water 用小火在锅中轻轻重新加热，加少许水

docs.text: Quick Info | 快速信息 - ⏱️ Prep Time | 准备时间: 5 minutes | 5分钟 - 🔥 Cook Time | 烹饪时间: 8 minutes | 8分钟 - 🍽️ Servings | 份量: 1 serving | 1人份 - 📊 Difficulty | 难度: Easy | 简单

docs.title: 📝 Description | 菜品介绍
docs.text:
English: This simple braised tomato dish showcases the natural umami and slight sweetness of ripe tomatoes. Cooked until tender with a rich sauce, it's perfect over rice or noodles. The recipe uses only tomatoes and basic seasonings, making it an ideal minimalist vegan meal that takes just 13 minutes to prepare.

中文： 这道简单的红烧番茄展现了成熟番茄的天然鲜味和微甜。煮至软嫩并带有浓郁酱汁，非常适合配米饭或面条。菜谱仅使用番茄和基本调味料，是理想的极简素食餐点，仅需13分钟即可完成。

docs.title: Step 1 | 第一步: Prepare the Tomatoes | 准备番茄
docs.text:
English: Wash the tomatoes thoroughly. Cut them into 2-3 cm cubes. If desired, you can peel them by blanching in boiling water for 30 seconds first. Peel and mince the garlic.

中文： 彻底清洗番茄。切成2-3厘米的方块。如需要，可以先在沸水中焯烫30秒去皮。大蒜去皮并切成细末。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: Peeling is optional but creates a smoother sauce texture. 去皮是可选的，但能创造更顺滑的酱汁质地。

docs.title: Step 2 | 第二步: Sauté the Aromatics | 炒香调料
docs.text:
English: Place a small pot or deep pan over medium heat. Add 8ml of cooking oil and heat for 20 seconds. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry for 10 seconds until fragrant.

中文： 将小锅或深煎锅置于中火上。加入8毫升食用油，加热20秒。加入蒜末，翻炒10秒至出香味。

⚠️ Important | 注意事项: Use medium heat to prevent the garlic from burning. 使用中火防止大蒜烧焦。

docs.title: Step 3 | 第三步: Add Tomatoes | 加入番茄
docs.text:
English: Add the tomato cubes to the pot and stir-fry for 2 minutes until they start to soften and release their juices. Add 5ml of soy sauce and stir well.

中文： 将番茄块加入锅中，翻炒2分钟至开始变软并释放汁液。加入5毫升酱油，充分搅拌。

🌟 Pro Tip | 专业技巧: Stir gently to avoid breaking the tomatoes too much. 轻轻搅拌以避免过度破坏番茄形状。

docs.title: Step 4 | 第四步: Braise | 红烧
docs.text:
English: Add 50ml of water, 2g of salt, and 3g of sugar to the pot. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes until the tomatoes are tender and the sauce has thickened slightly.

中文： 向锅中加入50毫升水、2克盐和3克糖。煮沸后转小火。盖上锅盖，慢炖5分钟至番茄软嫩且酱汁略微浓稠。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: The sugar balances the natural acidity of the tomatoes perfectly. 糖完美平衡了番茄的天然酸味。

docs.title: Step 5 | 第五步: Reduce and Serve | 收汁上桌
docs.text:
English: Remove the lid and cook for another 1-2 minutes over medium heat to reduce the sauce to your desired consistency. Transfer to a serving bowl and serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.

中文： 打开锅盖，用中火再煮1-2分钟，将酱汁收至理想浓稠度。装入碗中，趁热配蒸米饭或面条食用。

docs.text: Quick Info | 快速信息 - ⏱️ Prep Time | 准备时间: 8 minutes | 8分钟 - 🔥 Cook Time | 烹饪时间: 6 minutes | 6分钟 - 🍽️ Servings | 份量: 1 serving | 1人份 - 📊 Difficulty | 难度: Easy | 简单

docs.title: 📝 Description | 菜品介绍
docs.text:
English: This classic Chinese stir-fried green beans is crisp, tender, and flavorful. With minimal seasoning of just garlic and salt, it highlights the natural freshness of the beans. The key is to cook them until tender-crisp while maintaining their vibrant green color. A perfect healthy side dish ready in 14 minutes.

中文： 这道经典中式清炒四季豆脆嫩可口，风味十足。仅用大蒜和盐最少调味，突出了四季豆的天然清新。关键是煮至嫩脆同时保持鲜艳的翠绿色。一道完美的健康配菜，14分钟即可完成。

Notes on Measurements | 分量说明: - All measurements are precise in grams (g) or milliliters (ml) for consistency 所有分量均以克(g)或毫升(ml)为单位，保持一致性 - Choose firm, bright green beans for best texture 选择坚实、翠绿的四季豆以获得最佳口感 - Remove strings from older beans if present 如有老豆，去除豆筋

docs.title: Step 1 | 第一步: Prepare the Beans | 准备四季豆
docs.text:
English: Wash the green beans thoroughly. Trim off both ends and cut into 4-5 cm lengths. If the beans have strings along the sides, pull them off. Peel and mince the garlic finely.

中文： 彻底清洗四季豆。去掉两端，切成4-5厘米长的段。如果豆子两侧有豆筋，将其撕掉。大蒜去皮并切成细末。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: Uniform cutting ensures even cooking throughout. 均匀切割确保整体受热均匀。

docs.title: Step 2 | 第二步: Heat the Pan | 热锅
docs.text:
English: Place a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add 12ml of cooking oil and swirl to coat the bottom evenly. Heat for about 20 seconds until the oil shimmers.

中文： 将炒锅或大煎锅置于中大火上。加入12毫升食用油，晃动使油均匀覆盖锅底。加热约20秒至油微微冒烟。

⚠️ Important | 注意事项: Green beans need sufficient heat to cook properly and maintain their color. 四季豆需要足够的热量才能正确烹饪并保持颜色。

docs.title: Step 3 | 第三步: Stir-Fry with Garlic | 蒜香翻炒
docs.text:
English: Add the minced garlic to the hot oil and stir-fry for 10 seconds until fragrant. Immediately add the green beans and stir-fry vigorously for 2 minutes until they start to turn bright green.

中文： 将蒜末加入热油中，翻炒10秒至出香味。立即加入四季豆，快速翻炒2分钟至开始变成鲜绿色。

🌟 Pro Tip | 专业技巧: High heat helps seal in moisture and keeps the beans crisp. 大火有助于锁住水分并保持豆子脆爽。

docs.title: Step 4 | 第四步: Steam and Cook Through | 蒸煮煮熟
docs.text:
English: Add 30ml of water to the pan and immediately cover with a lid. Reduce heat to medium and let it steam for 3-4 minutes until the beans are tender but still crisp. Check by piercing with a fork.

中文： 向锅中加入30毫升水，立即盖上锅盖。转中火，蒸煮3-4分钟至豆子嫩但仍脆。用叉子刺穿检查。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: Properly cooked green beans should be tender-crisp, not mushy or raw. 正确烹饪的四季豆应该嫩脆，不是软烂或生的。

docs.title: Step 5 | 第五步: Season and Serve | 调味上桌
docs.text:
English: Remove the lid, add 2g of salt, and stir-fry for another 30 seconds until the water evaporates. Transfer to a serving plate and serve immediately while hot.

中文： 打开锅盖，加入2克盐，再翻炒30秒至水分蒸发。装入盘中，趁热立即食用。

docs.text: Quick Info | 快速信息 - ⏱️ Prep Time | 准备时间: 8 minutes | 8分钟 - 🔥 Cook Time | 烹饪时间: 4 minutes | 4分钟 - 🍽️ Servings | 份量: 1 serving | 1人份 - 📊 Difficulty | 难度: Easy | 简单

docs.title: 📝 Description | 菜品介绍
docs.text:
English: This simple stir-fried napa cabbage is a classic Chinese home-style dish that highlights the natural sweetness and crisp texture of the vegetable. Quick to prepare and low in calories, it's perfect for a light meal or as a side dish. The entire cooking process takes only 12 minutes.

中文： 这道简单的清炒大白菜是经典的中式家常菜，突出了蔬菜的天然甜味和脆爽口感。制作快速且低卡路里，非常适合作为清淡的一餐或配菜。整个烹饪过程仅需12分钟。

docs.text:

docs.title: Step 1 | 第一步: Prepare the Cabbage | 准备大白菜
docs.text:
English: Wash the napa cabbage thoroughly under running water. Separate the leaves and cut them into 4-5 cm wide strips. Peel and mince the garlic finely.

中文： 在流动水下彻底清洗大白菜。将菜叶分开，切成4-5厘米宽的条状。大蒜去皮并切成细末。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: Cut the white stem part and green leaf part separately, as they have different cooking times. 将白色菜帮和绿色菜叶分开切，因为它们的烹饪时间不同。

docs.title: Step 2 | 第二步: Heat the Pan | 热锅
docs.text:
English: Place a wok or frying pan over medium-high heat. Add 10ml of cooking oil and swirl to coat the bottom evenly. Heat for about 20 seconds until the oil is warm.

中文： 将炒锅或煎锅置于中大火上。加入10毫升食用油，晃动使油均匀覆盖锅底。加热约20秒至油温热。

⚠️ Important | 注意事项: Don't let the oil smoke, as this can affect the delicate flavor of the cabbage. 不要让油冒烟，否则会影响大白菜的细腻风味。

docs.title: Step 3 | 第三步: Stir-Fry the Stem | 翻炒菜帮
docs.text:
English: Add the minced garlic to the hot oil and stir-fry for 10 seconds until fragrant. First add the white stem parts of the cabbage and stir-fry for 1 minute until slightly softened.

中文： 将蒜末加入热油中，翻炒10秒至出香味。先加入大白菜的白色菜帮部分，翻炒1分钟至略微变软。

🌟 Pro Tip | 专业技巧: Cooking the stem first ensures both parts are perfectly done at the same time. 先炒菜帮可确保两部分同时达到完美熟度。

docs.title: Step 4 | 第四步: Add Leaves and Steam | 加入菜叶并蒸煮
docs.text:
English: Add the green leaf parts and 20ml of water to the pan. Immediately cover with a lid and let it steam for 1 minute. Remove the lid, add 2g of salt, and stir-fry for another 30 seconds until the water evaporates.

中文： 加入绿色菜叶部分和20毫升水到锅中。立即盖上锅盖，蒸煮1分钟。打开锅盖，加入2克盐，再翻炒30秒至水分蒸发。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: The brief steaming keeps the cabbage crisp-tender and preserves its nutrients. 短暂蒸煮保持大白菜脆嫩并保留营养。

docs.title: Step 5 | 第五步: Plate and Serve | 装盘上桌
docs.text:
English: Transfer the stir-fried napa cabbage to a serving plate. Serve immediately while hot to enjoy its fresh sweetness.

中文： 将清炒大白菜装入盘中。趁热立即食用以享受其清新甜味。

docs.title: 📝 Description | 菜品介绍
docs.text:
English: This classic Chinese-style stir-fried sweet corn highlights the natural sweetness of fresh corn kernels. With only salt as seasoning, it's a quick, healthy, and delicious side dish that takes just 10 minutes to prepare. The corn stays tender-crisp and retains its juicy flavor.

中文： 这道经典中式清炒甜玉米突出了新鲜玉米粒的天然甜味。仅用盐调味，是一道快速、健康、美味的配菜，仅需10分钟即可完成。玉米保持嫩脆口感，保留多汁风味。

docs.title: Step 1 | 第一步: Prepare the Corn | 准备玉米
docs.text:
English: If using whole corn cobs, remove the kernels by cutting downward with a sharp knife. Rinse the kernels under cold water and drain well. If using frozen corn, thaw completely and pat dry.

中文： 如果使用整根玉米棒，用刀向下切去除玉米粒。在冷水下冲洗玉米粒并充分沥干。如果使用冷冻玉米，完全解冻并拍干。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: To easily remove kernels, stand the cob upright on a cutting board and slice downward. 将玉米棒直立在砧板上，向下切片可轻松去除玉米粒。

docs.title: Step 2 | 第二步: Heat the Pan | 热锅
docs.text:
English: Place a wok or frying pan over medium-high heat. Add 10ml of cooking oil and swirl to coat the bottom evenly. Heat for about 20 seconds until the oil is warm.

中文： 将炒锅或煎锅置于中大火上。加入10毫升食用油，晃动使油均匀覆盖锅底。加热约20秒至油温热。

⚠️ Important | 注意事项: Don't let the oil smoke, as high heat can burn the delicate corn kernels. 不要让油冒烟，因为高温会烧焦娇嫩的玉米粒。

docs.title: Step 3 | 第三步: Stir-Fry the Corn | 翻炒玉米
docs.text:
English: Add the corn kernels to the hot oil and stir-fry continuously for 2-3 minutes until they start to turn slightly golden and fragrant. Keep stirring to prevent sticking.

中文： 将玉米粒加入热油中，持续翻炒2-3分钟至开始略微金黄并散发香味。不断搅拌防止粘锅。

🌟 Pro Tip | 专业技巧: Continuous stirring ensures even cooking and prevents the corn from burning. 持续搅拌确保均匀受热并防止玉米烧焦。

docs.title: Step 4 | 第四步: Steam and Season | 蒸煮与调味
docs.text:
English: Add 20ml of water to the pan and immediately cover with a lid. Let it steam for 1 minute to ensure the corn is cooked through. Remove the lid, add 2g of salt, and stir-fry for another 30 seconds until the water evaporates.

中文： 向锅中加入20毫升水，立即盖上锅盖。蒸煮1分钟以确保玉米熟透。打开锅盖，加入2克盐，再翻炒30秒至水分蒸发。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: The brief steaming keeps the corn tender while the quick stir-frying maintains its crispness. 短暂蒸煮保持玉米嫩滑，快速翻炒保持其脆爽。

docs.title: Step 5 | 第五步: Plate and Serve | 装盘上桌
docs.text:
English: Transfer the stir-fried corn to a serving plate. Serve immediately while hot to enjoy its natural sweetness and tender-crisp texture.

中文： 将清炒玉米装入盘中。趁热立即食用以享受其天然甜味和嫩脆口感。

docs.title: Stir-Fried Sweet Potato | 清炒红薯
🥘 Ingredients | 食材
docs.text: Ingredient 食材 Quantity 分量 Sweet Potato 红薯 200g 200克 Olive Oil 橄榄油 5ml 5毫升 Salt 盐 1g 1克 Water 水 30ml 30毫升

docs.title: 👨‍🍳 Instructions | 步骤
docs.text:
1. Peel and slice sweet potato thinly. 红薯去皮切薄片。
  2. Heat 5ml olive oil, add sweet potato. 加热5毫升橄榄油，加入红薯。
  3. Stir-fry 2 minutes, add 30ml water. 翻炒2分钟，加30毫升水。
  4. Cover, steam 3 minutes until tender. 盖盖，蒸3分钟至软。
  5. Add 1g salt, serve. 加1克盐，装盘。

docs.text: Ingredient 食材 Quantity 分量 Zucchini 西葫芦 200g 200克 Olive Oil 橄榄油 5ml 5毫升 Salt 盐 1g 1克

docs.title: 👨‍🍳 Instructions | 步骤
docs.text:
1. Slice zucchini into thin rounds. 西葫芦切成薄片。
  2. Heat 5ml olive oil for 15 seconds. 加热5毫升橄榄油15秒。
  3. Add zucchini, stir-fry 3 minutes. 加入西葫芦，翻炒3分钟。
  4. Add 1g salt, serve immediately. 加1克盐，立即装盘。
